## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A faithful vector of the Abshir mark, rebuilt from the legacy asset. Use it to signal Absher/Nafath verification steps - never as a generic decorative icon.

### Anatomy

The mark is a single vector group (2:3 portrait). No wordmark - mark only.

### Sizes

Five fixed sizes match the DS icon scale (height in px): 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64. Scale proportionally - never freehand.

### Tones

Three tones for different surfaces:

- Brand - the official Abshir green (#089247). Default; use on light neutral surfaces.
- Mono - bound to text/default; for single-colour / print / low-emphasis contexts.
- Inverse - bound to text/inverse (white); for dark surfaces and photography.

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Use Brand green on light neutral surfaces at a DS size.

Do

Use Inverse (white) on dark surfaces or photography.

Don’t

Don’t stretch, distort, rotate, or add shadows/effects - keep the exact vector and 2:3 ratio.

Don’t

Don’t recolour to a non-brand hue - only Brand / Mono / Inverse are allowed.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Rebuilt as clean vectors from the legacy Absher asset - no raster. The Brand green (#089247) is Abshir’s own colour and is intentionally NOT a Safqah token.

> **Tip:** Mono + Inverse fills are bound to text/default / text/inverse, so they adapt with the theme. Only Brand is fixed.

> **Warning:** It’s a third-party mark - use only to denote Absher/Nafath. Don’t repurpose it as a generic verified/lock icon.
